3 Step Anti-Acne TRIO | Complete Skin Recovery | Dark Spot & Redness Care

1. What is it?

Achieve the ultimate skin transformation with our 3 Step Anti-Acne TRIO. This comprehensive set is systematically designed to calm breakouts, fade stubborn post-acne marks, and rebuild a damaged skin barrier. High-performance K-beauty technology meet gentle, effective ingredients for a flawless complexion.

Step 1: 345 Relief Cream Mist (100ml)

An ultra-fine Dual-Layer Mist (Cream + Essence) that locks in all the goodness. Perfect for on-the-go hydration and fixing the skin barrier throughout the day.

Step 2: Vitamin C Boosting Serum (30ml)

A daily brightening powerhouse with 640,000 ppm of Sea Buckthorn Water. It targets melanin and restores vitality without the stinging sensation of pure Vitamin C.

Step 3: 345 Relief Cream (50ml)

Our best-selling Fungal Acne Safe moisturizer. It focuses on recovering skin from acne damage using a potent blend of Niacinamide, PDRN, and Panthenol.

2. Key Point

(1) The Ultimate Climate-Ready Routine

- Zero-Stickiness, Maximum Glow: Each product is optimized for high humidity. From the serum's weightless finish to the mist's micro-distribution, this trio provides a \"glass skin\" look without feeling heavy or greasy.

- 24/7 Care: Use the Serum and Cream for your morning/night foundation, and carry the Mist to combat \"Air-Con Dryness\" in offices or malls.

(2) Proven Clinical Results

- Dark Spot Care: 1.91% Decrease in Melanin Level within 2 weeks. (Vitamin C Boosting Serum)

- Deep Soothing: 8.88% immediate improvement in skin calming. (345 Relief Cream)

- Intense Hydration: 117.34% boost in moisture levels. (345 Relief Cream)

*Tested by Korea Institute of Dermatological Sciences

3. Especially For

Ideal for those struggling with:

- Persistent Post-Acne Marks: Fading red and brown spots left behind after breakouts.

- Dull & Sensitive Skin: Wanting a brighter complexion with zero irritation.

4. Key Ingredients

- Sea Buckthorn Water (63%): A natural Vitamin C & E bomb for intensive tone care.

- Niacinamide & Tranexamic Acid: A synergy that blocks melanin and refines skin texture.

- Rice Bran Water & Panthenol: Deeply nourishes and strengthens the moisture barrier.

- Centella & Madecassoside: The gold standard for calming irritated, red skin instantly.

Essential Travel Skincare Set 4pcs
A set of signature products in travel size is conveniently carried around for use on the go, helping to soften, refine and smooth skin.
Set includes:
Facial Treatment Gentle Cleanser 20g
Cleansing and pampering skin, rich PITERA™ and nourishing ingredients leave skin feeling smooth, fresh and clean.
Facial Treatment Clear Lotion 30ml
A good parer of Facial Treatment Essence helps with secondary skin cleansing, soothing and softening skin to assist better absorption of nutrients from subsequent skincare products.
Facial Treatment Essence 30ml
Signature PITERA™ and various ingredients help improve the appearance of fine lines, balance pH and improve skin texture, deeply nourishing skin while boosting skin absorption power for a radiant glow
Skinpower Advanced Cream 15g
This cream energises and plumps skin to refine skin texture, rejuvenating to reveal translucent and glowing skin from within
Ingredients:
Common Ingredients:
•PITERA™ : Balancing skin pH, nourishing skin.

Facial Treatment Gentle Cleanser
Wet face with water, put an appropriate amount on palm and add water, rub to lather, gently massage your face, then rinse thoroughly with warm water.
Facial Treatment Clear Lotion
After cleansing in the morning and evening, take an appropriate amount with cotton pad, apply evenly to face, and then gently pat with hands for better absorption.
Facial Treatment Essence
Pour 2-3 drops of serum into hands, bring palms together to moisten hands, then gently glide from inside to outside of face, pat and massage until fully absorbed.
Skinpower Cream
Take pearl-sized amount and apply to forehead, cheeks and chin with fingertips, slowly spread from centre of face outwards to entire face.
